title: Drake Seemingly Shades Serena Williams on Sexyy Red's Tennis Photo - NewsBreak
text:
By Preksha Sharma ,
37 minutes ago Image Credit: Gabe Ginsberg/Getty Images Drake allegedly stirred the pot on social media after sharing tennis-themed photos with rapper Sexyy Red and shading Serena Williams. Under the same post, he quietly liked a comment that took a shot at his ex. The post saw Sexyy Red and Drake on a tennis court in the game’s outfit. One user praised Red while dismissing Williams, and the singer liked that comment, causing controversy.
Drake seemingly shades Serena Williams under the tennis post Drake uploaded pictures with Sexyy Red on his Instagram in tennis gear, standing on a tennis court. He captioned the picture, “I said tennis lesson she said where’s the bracelet or the necklace.” Given that Serena Williams was a pro tennis player, a user commented under the post drawing comparisons to her.
They wrote, “Serena Williams upgrade ??,” allegedly hinting that Sexyy Red is a better version of Drake’s ex. The singer reportedly responded by liking the comment. This move added fuel to the whole story.
Serena Williams and Drake had dated on and off from 2011 to 2015. This is not the first time that the ex-couple has been caught in such a controversy. In 2022, Drake drew attention for his lines on his song, ‘Middle of the Ocean.” Many fans interpreted it as a jab at Williams and her husband Alexis Ohanian.
The world knows the Kendrick Lamar and Drake feud. Lamar sang his diss track called ‘Not Like Us’ that he made for Drake during the Super Bowl halftime show. Serena Williams went viral for dancing on its beat. Some fans felt like this was her response to Drake. However, Williams had insisted that the cameo was not intended to target her ex. She wanted to use the platform and represent Compton, the neighborhood where she was raised.
As for Drake, he has not offered a public statement about this comment exchange. It remains under speculation if Drake meant it as a shade, posing with Sexyy Red.
